title: Resolution urging Albany to require full insurance coverage for lactation care
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation requiring health insurers to cover all lactation consultation and counseling services without restrictions and to reimburse providers accordingly. It cites concerns that insurers have limited coverage to inpatient visits, capped the number of covered visits, or treated parent and infant as a single patient, undermining Affordable Care Act protections. The resolution notes New York State has fewer lactation consultants per capita than the national average.
